note: Null source values are omitted. A missing country-year is not zero. These 11 indicators supplement the published 17-indicator snapshot and are not part of its checksum.

indicators.name: Merchandise exports (current US$)
indicators.definition: Merchandise exports in current US dollars. This is the scale of goods sold abroad, not an order book.

indicators.name: Merchandise imports (current US$)
indicators.definition: Merchandise imports in current US dollars.

indicators.name: Manufactures exports (% of merchandise exports)
indicators.definition: Manufactures as a share of merchandise exports. Context for apparel and light manufacturing, not a garment order.

indicators.name: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports)
indicators.definition: Manufactures as a share of merchandise imports.

indicators.name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.definition: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing value added as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.definition: Manufacturing value added as a share of GDP.

indicators.name: Services, value added (% of GDP)
indicators.definition: Services value added as a share of GDP. An aggregate, not one service line.

indicators.name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
indicators.definition: Consumer price inflation, annual percent. Price context for contracts, not a product price.

indicators.name: Official exchange rate (LCU per US$, period average)
indicators.definition: Official exchange rate, local currency units per US dollar, period average.

indicators.name: Access to electricity (% of population)
indicators.definition: Access to electricity. Infrastructure context for production and services.

indicators.name: Mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people)
indicators.definition: Mobile cellular subscriptions per 100 people. Digital reach context for services, media, and payments.
